name: wallet-economy
description: Lux economy verification: check balance, view accounts and transactions via API, and verify the wallet gateway page.

steps.prompt: Fetch node status to read the current Lux balance
Verify the status endpoint returns 200 with a balance
Navigate to the wallet page on the gateway
Verify the wallet page displays the current Lux balance
steps.expected: balance amount visible on wallet page

steps.prompt: Fetch all ledger accounts to verify the accounts API works
steps.verify: response is an array of account objects

steps.prompt: Fetch recent transactions from the ledger
steps.verify: response is an array of transaction objects

steps.prompt: Return to the wallet page to check the transaction history section
Verify the transaction history section is rendered on the wallet page
steps.expected: transaction history or recent activity visible

steps.prompt: Evaluate the wallet and economy experience: Is the balance prominently displayed? Is transaction history understandable? Are send/receive flows discoverable? Does the Lux economy feel tangible?
